## UD-2B2 additions
- `APEX_REQUIRED_CANONICAL_CONTROL_PLANE_STATE_MODEL_INCOMPLETE` — The frozen UD-2 operational states were not exposed by the Gateway sync-status contract, leaving the dashboard unable to distinguish authentication, schema, readiness, and sync failures. Guard: retain internal run lifecycle fields, add one Gateway-owned canonical state derivation authority, expose it through the existing status route, and prove every branch without clearing last-good data.
- `APEX_REQUIRED_RUNTIME_ACCEPTANCE_HARNESS_ABSENT` — A required runtime/browser state matrix was not certifiable because no canonical reusable acceptance harness existed, despite source tests and authenticated browser authority passing. Guard: implement one bounded repository-owned harness, prove its self-tests and named runtime modes, and use its current evidence as the UD-2 runtime authority. The current discovery `UD2_FOUR_SERVICE_BROWSER_ACCEPTANCE_OWNER_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED` is bound to this class; the repair is the repository-owned four-service controller plus canonical Layer-B spec.
- `APEX_PS51_BRACKET_PATH_WILDCARD_RENAME_DEFECT` — PowerShell treated `[[...slug]]` as wildcard syntax during route normalization, so the intended rename did not occur. Guard: use `-LiteralPath` for bracketed route paths and verify the resulting route file identity.
- `APEX_PAYLOAD_PUBLIC_EXPORT_ASSUMPTION_DEFECT` — `handleServerFunctions` was guessed from utilities and package-private deep paths, both rejected by Payload 3.63.0. Guard: bind the Admin bridge only to the installed public `@payloadcms/next/layouts` export and require typecheck/build proof.

## WatanyBot Phase 7 Wave 2G.1 additions
- `APEX_PHASE7_BATCH_GATE_DEPENDENT_CONTINUATION_RECURRENCE` — Wave 2G combined validation continued later gates after a failed web-admin typecheck; the reusable Process runner now requires observed PASS, exit 0, and empty stderr before dependent gates execute. Recurrence of `APEX_PHASE6_BATCH_SEMICOLON_CHAIN_CAN_CONTINUE_AFTER_NATIVE_CHILD_FAILURE`.
- `APEX_PHASE7_POST_MUTATION_SOURCE_EDIT_INVALIDATED_EARLIER_TEST_AND_BUILD_EVIDENCE` — source changed after earlier frontend tests/build; all affected proof must be rerun from final bytes.
- `APEX_PHASE7_LAST_ADMIN_TARGET_ROW_LOCK_DOES_NOT_SERIALIZE_ADMINISTRATIVE_INVARIANT_SET` — target-row locking alone permits concurrent authority removal from different administrator rows; use one transaction-scoped shared invariant lock before evaluating the full active administrator set.

## Watany Control Center V1.0.8 regression additions
- `APEX_PHASE8_V107_MOF_ATTACHMENT_GATE_BLOCK` — Root cause: the isolated Gateway MOF regression deterministically returned the missing-document fallback instead of the embedded JPEG preview because the candidate runtime did not close over the attachment-complete MOF document/source lineage. Guard: run the exact MOF attachment regression in an isolated candidate, require the expected JPEG data URL and reference source response, and classify any failure as a functional source-closure blocker rather than a timeout or contention flake.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V107_UNRELATED_WORK_RELEASE_GATE_FALSE_BLOCK_OR_UNRESOLVED_CLASSIFICATION` — Root cause: the V1.0.7 release gate treated preserved, unrelated dirty-tree work as a blocking release failure even when it was outside the approved release roots. Guard: classify every dirty path, preserve unrelated work byte-for-byte, exclude it from the candidate, require zero unknown classifications, and block only on unrelated work that is included, mutated, deleted, or unresolved.

## Watany Control Center V1.1.0 proof materialization additions
- `APEX_PHASE8_V110_REQUIRED_PROOF_MATERIALIZATION_CONTROLLER_ABSENT` — Root cause: the V1.0.7 finalizer emitted the required proof filenames as `UNVERIFIED` and no executable current-byte-bound materialization controller existed. Guard: maintain one executable PS5.1 controller that freezes candidate identity, runs or rejects each proof domain explicitly, and computes the verdict from booleans.
- `APEX_PHASE8_CURRENT_BYTE_BOUND_PREDECESSOR_PROOF_REQUIRED` — Root cause: historical PASS artifacts were available without proof that their relevant source/runtime bytes matched the current candidate. Guard: consume predecessors only after ZIP, sidecar, membership, relevant source hash, and runtime contract checks all pass; otherwise rerun or block.
- `APEX_PHASE8_STALE_PREDECESSOR_PROOF_REUSE_FORBIDDEN` — Root cause: a predecessor proof could appear complete while being stale after gateway or RAG changes. Guard: emit `PROOF_STRATEGY=RERUN_CURRENT` or `BLOCKED`, never current PASS, when compatibility is not proven.
- `APEX_PHASE8_UNVERIFIED_PROOF_SURFACE_CANNOT_AUTHORIZE_PHASE9` — Root cause: local product Green Matrix was mistaken for complete Phase 8 authorization while mandatory proof domains remained unverified. Guard: every mandatory proof must be boolean PASS before Phase 9 handoff is READY.

## Watany Control Center V1.1.0 regression additions
- `APEX_FOUNDATION_CONTROLLER_SCAFFOLD_ONLY_GAP` — Root cause: V1.0.0 intentionally stopped at the interactive Payload scaffold boundary and therefore could not satisfy the owner-authorized build objective. Guard: Use deterministic official upstream sparse-checkout template acquisition, exact package-version pinning, build proof and runtime probes.
- `APEX_MANUAL_SUCCESS_TOKEN_AFTER_FAILED_INTERACTIVE_COMMAND` — Root cause: Interactive console allowed a user-entered PASS token after an earlier throw. Guard: Success tokens are emitted only by a single fail-closed controller execution after exit/output/failure-token checks.
- `APEX_CONTROLLER_ARTIFACT_LOCAL_FILE_ABSENT` — Root cause: Initial controller had not been saved to the local filesystem. Guard: Exact file existence, size, SHA-256 and parser proof are mandatory before runtime.
- `APEX_LAUNCH_EVIDENCE_PATH_CONCATENATION_SEPARATOR_DEFECT` — Root cause: A manually reproduced launcher concatenated controller-launch and the timestamp without a path separator. Guard: All evidence paths are created with Join-Path only.

## Watany Control Center V1.1.1 regression additions
- `APEX_PS51_COMMAND_ARRAY_COMMA_BOUND_TO_JOIN_PATH_CHILD_PATH` — Root cause: In Windows PowerShell 5.1, unparenthesized Join-Path invocations inside an array expression ended with commas, causing the comma to bind to the ChildPath argument and produce System.Object[] conversion failure. Guard: Never terminate an unparenthesized command invocation with a comma inside array construction. Parenthesize each Join-Path expression or emit one expression per line, and run the self-source regression scan before Phase 0 authority resolution.

## Watany Control Center Phase 8 V1.0.12 regression additions
- `APEX_PHASE8_POST_MATRIX_STATUS_TEXT_CONFLATION` — Root cause: the prior controller kept the post-matrix hash gate `BLOCKED` because upstream proof domains were blocked, despite zero release-source, lockfile, package-manifest, RAG, and residue drift metrics. Guard: recompute this gate only from typed zero-drift and stability metrics; do not inherit an upstream status string.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V112_ISOLATED_CANDIDATE_GIT_METADATA_ASSUMPTION` — Root cause: the current isolated candidate is a source copy without `.git`, but the first V1.0.12 identity implementation invoked Git inside that directory. Guard: prove candidate filesystem and manifest identity separately, and obtain Git HEAD only from the canonical workspace repository.

## Watany Control Center V1.1.2 regression additions
- `APEX_DOCKER_CLI_PRESENT_ENGINE_DAEMON_NOT_RUNNING` — Root cause: Docker CLI and Compose were installed and callable, but the Docker Desktop Linux engine named-pipe endpoint was absent, so compose could not contact the daemon and PostgreSQL never started. Guard: Prove Docker engine readiness with docker info before any compose operation. If Docker Desktop is installed but stopped, use the official docker desktop status/start interface or bounded GUI fallback, then poll docker info. Never classify compose/DB failure until daemon readiness has been separately proven.

## Watany Control Center V1.1.3 regression additions
- `APEX_PHASE8_V113_PS51_MANIFEST_MEMBERSHIP_NESTED_AUTOMATIC_VARIABLE_PARSE_DEFECT` — Registered after the first V1.0.13 controller parser proof rejected a nested `$_` membership expression and malformed `.Count` access. Guard: bind each manifest lookup path to a named local variable, materialize counts before object construction, and require external PS5.1 parser proof before execution.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V113_PS51_FAILURE_LIST_SERIALIZATION_SHAPE_DEFECT` — Registered after V1.0.13 runtime closeout rejected direct serialization of a `System.Collections.Generic.List[object]`. Guard: materialize typed failure collections through explicit enumeration before JSON serialization.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V113_PS51_FINAL_STATUS_INLINE_IF_RUNTIME_DEFECT` — Registered after V1.0.13 exact resume reached final status assembly and Windows PowerShell 5.1 treated inline `if` expressions as a command. Guard: compute every final status token in separate statements before concatenation.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V114_PS51_FINAL_STATUS_INLINE_IF_RUNTIME_DEFECT` — Registered after V1.0.14 exact resume reached final status assembly and Windows PowerShell 5.1 treated inline `if` expressions as a command. Guard: compute every baseline and final status token in separate statements before concatenation.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V114_VALIDATION_OVERLAY_NOT_MOUNTED_IN_TEST_WORKTREE` — Registered after the validation-only test copied with byte parity but the focused runner remained bound to the frozen candidate root and executed only 3 files/57 tests. Guard: create a disposable full candidate harness copy, overlay the validation-only test there, and prove the production candidate hash/manifest remains unchanged.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V115_CANDIDATE_HARNESS_RUNTIME_METADATA_MISSING` — Registered after explicit Vitest invocation from the disposable candidate-derived harness could not resolve `package.json`, workspace metadata, or the repository-installed Vitest executable. Guard: copy only required workspace/package/runtime metadata and dependency material into the disposable harness, record their hashes, and never mutate the frozen production candidate.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V115_DISPOSABLE_HARNESS_FULL_DEPENDENCY_TREE_COPY_NONCONVERGENT_RUNTIME` — Registered after copying the uncontrolled canonical dependency tree made disposable harness materialization excessive/slow and produced no authoritative runtime evidence. Guard: use a disposable junction-backed dependency binding, an explicit canonical package runtime, or an isolated frozen-lockfile install; never copy the full dependency tree as a workaround.
- `APEX_TERMINAL_STALE_SCROLLBACK_OR_REPLAY_MUST_NOT_BE_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE` — Registered after stale terminal output replayed earlier parser diagnostics during a later runtime attempt. Guard: accept runtime proof only from fresh durable evidence files containing the current controller SHA, run ID, child process context, and captured exit/output artifacts.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V116_HARNESS_WORKSPACE_TSC_EXTENDS_TARGET_MISSING` — Registered after the minimal harness resolved dependencies but Vitest could not transform any explicit test because `apps/gateway-api/tsconfig.json` extends the absent `packages/config/tsconfig.base.json`. Guard: copy the exact required workspace config target into the disposable harness and capture its hash; do not broaden the candidate or copy unrelated workspace trees.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V116_HARNESS_RELEASE_FILES_ONLY_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE` — Registered after explicit Vitest collected all four validation files but could not resolve their Gateway source imports because the harness contained only release-member files. Guard: copy the frozen candidate Gateway source tree required by the tests into the disposable harness, preserve validation-only manifest membership, and record source hash parity.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V116_ROOT_NODE_MODULES_JUNCTION_BREAKS_PNPM_PACKAGE_LINK_RESOLUTION` — Registered after root dependency junction reuse allowed Vitest itself to run but failed package imports because pnpm package links resolve through the Gateway package-local `node_modules` topology. Guard: bind the disposable Gateway package `node_modules` to the canonical Gateway package dependency directory and capture both identities; do not flatten or copy the dependency tree.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V116_JUNCTIONED_PNPM_CLI_PATH_REWRITES_VITEST_STORE_TARGET` — Registered after invoking Vitest through a junctioned package dependency path rewrote the pnpm store target into the disposable harness path, causing Node to fail before test execution. Guard: use the canonical package runtime executable with explicit absolute disposable test paths, or perform an isolated frozen-lockfile install; never accept a rewritten junction CLI path.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V116_CANONICAL_RUNTIME_STILL_RESOLVES_JUNCTIONED_VITEST_STORE_PATH` — Registered after canonical package cwd plus absolute disposable test paths still resolved the Vitest CLI through a junctioned pnpm store target and failed before collection. Guard: use an isolated frozen-lockfile install when both disposable junction and canonical-runtime strategies preserve an invalid store path.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V116_VITEST_CHILD_NO_TERMINAL_OUTPUT_OR_EXIT_EVIDENCE` — Registered after the isolated frozen-lockfile install completed successfully but the explicit Vitest child remained responsive without producing terminal stdout, stderr, or an authoritative exit result. Guard: resolve the installed Vitest entry from package metadata and execute a bounded direct-Node probe with durable stdout/stderr/process-result evidence before any suite-level retry.
- `APEX_PHASE8_NATIVE_TEST_CHILD_PROCESS_TREE_OWNERSHIP_UNPROVEN` — Registered because the prior package-manager execution path did not durably prove the parent and descendant process identities before termination. Guard: capture parent PID, descendant PIDs, names, command lines, start times, CPU snapshots, and ownership before terminating only the disposable validation tree.
- `APEX_PHASE8_PACKAGE_MANAGER_CHILD_CHAIN_MAY_OBSCURE_REAL_VITEST_PROCESS` — Registered because the pnpm child chain can obscure whether the actual Vitest runtime, a worker, or a wrapper owns the stall. Guard: use direct `node.exe` plus a proven Vitest entrypoint for the discriminating fourth-test probe and record the exact argv and cwd.
- `APEX_PHASE8_TIMEOUT_MUST_CAPTURE_PROCESS_TREE_BEFORE_TERMINATION` — Registered because timeout evidence is incomplete unless process-tree state is captured before cleanup. Guard: persist pre-timeout tree, bounded output tails, CPU/listener probes, and post-exit tree before terminating disposable processes; classify unresolved states as blocked.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V117_V116_HARNESS_INSTALLED_VITEST_METADATA_ABSENT` — Registered after the preserved V1.0.16 evidence harness was found without an installed Vitest package manifest or executable entry, preventing the mandated direct-Node discrimination from starting. Guard: preserve the V1.0.16 harness identity as incomplete, do not infer a Vitest runtime from file presence, and require a new materially different validation harness with a frozen install and proven package metadata before direct execution.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V117_VITEST_ENTRY_RESOLUTION_ASSUMED_PACKAGE_LOCAL_LAYOUT` — Registered because the V1.0.17 resolver assumed Vitest must exist below `apps/gateway-api/node_modules`; the repository declares it at the workspace root. Guard: resolve through the actual pnpm workspace/package graph from both workspace and package roots.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V117_PNPM_WORKSPACE_DEPENDENCY_OWNERSHIP_NOT_PROVEN` — Registered because prior evidence did not classify whether Vitest was root-owned, package-owned, shared, transitive, or absent. Guard: persist manifests and bounded `pnpm list`, `pnpm why`, and version-command evidence before execution.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V117_AUTH_TEST_INVENTORY_CARDINALITY_CONTRADICTION` — Registered because the V1.0.17 harness identity reported one discovered test while predecessor execution required four. Guard: derive and persist exactly four sealed inventory rows with existence, source/hash parity, and validation-only membership fields.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V117_CONTROLLER_ARGUMENT_TYPES_DO_NOT_MATCH_CLOSEOUT_DEFECT` — Registered because V1.0.17 closeout failed with `Argument types do not match`. Guard: materialize generic collections before serialization and validate every closeout artifact shape.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V117_FINAL_STATUS_NOT_STARTED_AFTER_EXECUTION_DEFECT` — Registered because V1.0.17 execution left `FINAL_STATUS.txt` as `NOT_STARTED` after the controller ran. Guard: precreate artifacts and always write a terminal `PASS` or `BLOCKED` status in the finalization path.
- `APEX_PHASE8_INSTALLED_DEPENDENCY_STATE_MUST_BE_CONSUMED_IN_SAME_FRESH_HARNESS_RUN` — Registered because installed dependency state was not preserved as an authoritative runtime in the predecessor harness. Guard: install, resolve, probe, execute, and capture evidence in one fresh run before cleanup.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V118_FRESH_HARNESS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG_TARGET_OMITTED` — Registered after fresh frozen installation and Vitest resolution passed, but all four suites failed before collection because `apps/gateway-api/tsconfig.json` extends the omitted `packages/config/tsconfig.base.json`. Guard: copy the exact referenced workspace config target into the disposable harness and capture its source/harness hash before runtime execution; do not broaden the production release membership.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V118_FRESH_HARNESS_WORKSPACE_PACKAGE_SOURCE_OMITTED` — Registered after the config target was repaired and the fourth test passed, but the four-file run could not load `@watany/kb` because the harness copied package source directories without their package manifests/entrypoints. Guard: copy exact workspace package metadata and source required by the resolved package graph, preserving validation-only membership and recording parity.
- `APEX_PHASE8_PS51_NATIVE_WRAPPER_EXITCODE_NULL_MUST_USE_LASTEXITCODE` — Registered after `pnpm.cmd` completed with authoritative output but `Start-Process.Process.ExitCode` was null through the wrapper boundary. Guard: invoke the trusted native launcher directly with the call operator, capture `$LASTEXITCODE` immediately, and retain stdout/stderr files.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V118_FRESH_HARNESS_WORKSPACE_PACKAGE_EXPORT_SOURCE_OMITTED` — Registered after workspace package manifests were added and the fourth test passed, but the full suite failed when `@watany/core/shared-engines` could not resolve from the copied package. Guard: preserve the package's actual exported subpath source and metadata required by the test import graph; do not infer that copying only `src` is sufficient.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V118_WORKSPACE_PACKAGE_DIRECTORY_NAME_ASSUMED` — Registered after the package export was found under `packages/watany-core`, while the fresh harness controller incorrectly assumed `packages/core`. Guard: derive workspace package directories from actual package manifests and names; never infer a directory from the scoped package suffix.
- `APEX_PHASE8_V118_VITEST_ANSI_SUMMARY_CARDINALITY_PARSE_DEFECT` — Registered because ANSI-styled Vitest summary lines were not recognized by the controller's plain-text count regex, causing a passing fourth test to be recorded as zero collected files. Guard: normalize ANSI control sequences before parsing summary counts and retain raw output separately.
- `APEX_PAYLOAD_OFFICIAL_TEMPLATE_TEST_USER_SCHEMA_DRIFT` — Root cause: Payload v3.88.0 blank-template tests/helpers/seedUser.ts seeds users with email and password only, while Watany Users requires role. The official tsconfig includes all TypeScript test files, so Next production build correctly type-checked the stale fixture and failed. Guard: Before type generation and build, structurally validate and adapt the official blank-template testUser fixture to include role SUPERADMIN. Refuse unknown template shapes and keep tests inside TypeScript scope.

Guard: materialize command names and arguments before invocation, bind every probe to its explicit package working directory, execute dependent checks as separate noninteractive steps, and preserve native exit/stdout/stderr evidence. ## Watany Control Center V1.1.4 regression additions
- `APEX_ERPNEXT_COMPOSE_UP_TIMEOUT_AFTER_RESOURCES_STARTED` — Root cause: The ERPNext quick-test docker compose up command exceeded the controller timeout while large images were still pulling/extracting and services were being created. Evidence later in the same captured stderr showed the ERPNext frontend, backend, queues, scheduler and websocket reached Started, so command timeout alone was not valid proof that compose startup failed. Guard: Treat compose timeout as INDETERMINATE, not immediate failure. Reconcile with docker compose ps --all, probe the ERPNext HTTP endpoint, and capture service logs before assigning a final ERP status.
- `APEX_GIT_SAFETY_GATE_IGNORED_NEW_RUNTIME_WINDOW_DELTA` — Root cause: V1.1.3 recorded a new Git delta in apps/web-user/src/theme/watany-v4/shell.css between entry and final status but still emitted K_PRODUCTION_SAFETY=PASS. Evidence cannot attribute that path to the controller or an external concurrent editor, therefore PASS was not supportable. Guard: Any new Git status line not present at entry must block the production-safety gate unless it is an explicitly allowlisted controller-owned evidence/governance path. Never infer external ownership.

Guard: normalize frozen manifest entries explicitly from scalar or array-shaped JSON before path or hash operations.

### Watany Control Center CRM Phase 8 V1.0.2 dependency recovery additions

- `APEX_PHASE8_CLEAN_CONTROLLER_GATE_EXECUTION_CHAIN_UNIMPLEMENTED` — The clean Phase 8 helper set only exposed readiness stubs and the orchestrator dispatched SecurityPreflight, ERP readiness, and CRM canary; it did not execute the required isolated source, dependency, matrix, evidence, or reseal gates. Guard: every mandatory gate must receive an explicit PASS or BLOCKED result and no final seal may be emitted from an incomplete chain.
- `APEX_PHASE8_CLEAN_CONTROLLER_EVIDENCE_RESEAL_UNIMPLEMENTED` — The clean Evidence and Reseal helpers emitted readiness markers only and could not create the mandatory frozen evidence package or independent ZIP reopen sidecar. Guard: finalize evidence before hashing, create the ZIP only after artifact freeze, and independently verify membership and byte parity before any release token.
- `APEX_PHASE8_CLEAN_CONTROLLER_NATIVE_ARGUMENT_CARDINALITY` — The clean Process helper passed a string array positionally through PowerShell, allowing command arguments and output-directory binding to flatten or shift under Windows PowerShell 5.1. Guard: bind native argument arrays and output paths by parameter name and prove the exact invoked command result.
- `APEX_PHASE8_CLEAN_CONTROLLER_LONG_NATIVE_CHILD_RUNTIME_DIVERGENCE` — The standalone bounded Gateway/Web commands pass, but the clean controller’s child-process invocation exits nonzero with empty stdout while only a Node listener warning is captured. Guard: preserve the controller-specific failure and require a reproducible child invocation with complete stdout/stderr and exit proof before matrix PASS.
- `APEX_PHASE8_CLEAN_CONTROLLER_LONG_RUNNING_CHILD_PROCESS_RUNTIME_DIVERGENCE` — The clean controller’s long-running child transport diverges from the identical standalone Node/Vitest invocation despite matching the declared command, working directory, and environment intent. Guard: use an OS process API with explicit Windows argv quoting, inherited execution environment, raw stdout/stderr files, observed process termination, and real exit-code proof.
- `APEX_PHASE8_API_AUTH_EXPECTED_TEST_POSTGRES_5434_RUNTIME_UNOWNED_OR_UNPROVISIONED` — API auth fixtures default to the repository-documented disposable test database on host port 5434, but no owned runtime was listening while the repository compose defaults to 5433. Guard: provision only a separate project-scoped PostgreSQL service with isolated storage and test-only settings, preserve all existing database runtimes, and prove cleanup afterward.
- `APEX_PHASE8_GATEWAY_FULL_SUITE_AUTH_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` — The current Gateway suite collected 74 files but 28 auth-negative assertions failed because the repository auth service at `127.0.0.1:4000` was not listening. Guard: preserve the service endpoint and failed assertions, prove the repository-owned service runtime before rerunning, and do not convert a partial suite into Gateway PASS.
- `APEX_PHASE8_RAG_TEST_RUNTIME_COPY_CONCURRENCY_COLLISION` — Parallel Gateway test workers attempted to initialize the same disposable RAG copy and Windows returned `EBUSY` during `CopyFile`. Guard: bind each test process to a unique disposable runtime path while preserving the canonical source as read-only.

### 2026-09-18 — PAYLOAD_DIAGNOSTIC_HTTP_ERROR_PIPE_TO_JSON_MASKING
- Status: ACTIVE regression guard.
- Failure class: a diagnostic command used `curl -f` piped directly into JSON parsing; an upstream HTTP 500 produced no JSON body, causing a secondary JSONDecodeError that obscured the primary Payload API failure.
- Required guard: capture HTTP status and response body separately; never parse JSON unless the HTTP result is successful and the body is non-empty; preserve the primary HTTP failure and sanitized body excerpt.
- Scope: Payload production diagnostics, sync probes, deployment admission, and similar HTTP+JSON validation chains.

### APEX_SSH_MAXSTARTUPS_PREAUTH_RANDOM_DROP_DEFECT
- Status: ACTIVE
- Discovery: 2026-09-18 production admission.
- Failure: server sshd remained listening on port 22 but reported `31 of 10-100 startups` with many unauthenticated external sessions; client connections were reset during key exchange before authentication.
- Risk: valid deployment keys can appear broken and admission/deployment can fail nondeterministically even though SSH authentication previously passed.
- Guard: classify pre-auth `kex_exchange_identification` resets separately from key/auth failures; inspect sshd listener/startup pressure and use bounded serialized retries before any key/server mutation.
- Regression rule: never rotate keys, edit authorized_keys, or alter deployment credentials solely in response to a pre-auth MaxStartups reset.

### APEX_POWERSHELL_PARSER_HARNESS_OUTER_EXPANSION_DEFECT
- Status: ACTIVE GUARD
- Trigger: parser-preflight command embeds PowerShell `$variables` inside an outer PowerShell command string and the outer host expands them before the child parser receives the command.
- Failure signature: parser harness itself reports missing arguments / empty pipe / missing operand before target artifact parsing begins.
- Guard: run independent parser preflight through a quoting boundary that preserves `$` tokens (for example cmd.exe invoking powershell.exe), or use a separately parser-proven checker artifact.
- Disposition: harness failure only; never classify target script parser status from this failure.

### APEX_PAYLOAD_PRODUCTION_CANONICAL_COLLECTIONS_EMPTY_OR_MISBOUND
- Status: ACTIVE
- Trigger: Authenticated production Payload API returns HTTP 200 with `totalDocs=0` for `procedures`, `documents`, and `gateway-admins`, while anonymous access correctly returns 403 and token-authenticated access succeeds.
- Impact: Canonical Payload source cannot populate Gateway Procedures; triggering sync would produce an empty candidate (now rejected by local repair) and does not restore content.
- Required disposition: Before any sync/deployment activation, prove the effective production Payload database/schema binding and determine whether expected canonical rows exist in another database/schema or were never migrated.
- Regression guard: Production admission must assert positive canonical source counts (at minimum published Procedures > 0) before sync activation.

### APEX_PAYLOAD_DB_CENSUS_DIRECT_PG_MODULE_ASSUMPTION
- Status: ACTIVE
- Trigger: production census uses `require('pg')` from `apps/payload-cms` without proving that `pg` is directly resolvable there.
- Evidence: live Node v20.20.2 returned `MODULE_NOT_FOUND: pg` while Payload itself remained healthy through `@payloadcms/db-postgres`.
- Guard: database census must use an actually available runtime boundary (for example local `psql`) or prove module resolution before execution.

### APEX_SSH_RETRY_REPEATS_DETERMINISTIC_REMOTE_FAILURE
- Status: ACTIVE
- Trigger: SSH retry loop retries when transport/auth succeeded but the remote diagnostic exited nonzero for a deterministic application error.
- Evidence: the same `MODULE_NOT_FOUND: pg` remote failure was repeated on all 8 authenticated SSH attempts.
- Guard: retry only transport/pre-auth failures; once a remote command starts and returns deterministic application output, fail closed without repeating it.
### APEX_EMBEDDED_BASH_HEREDOC_ESCAPES_POWERSHELL_HERESTRING
- Status: ACTIVE
- Trigger: generated PowerShell embeds a Bash heredoc/SQL heredoc inside a PowerShell here-string and the final artifact parser sees the heredoc body as PowerShell syntax.
- Evidence: exact-byte parser gate on `watany_payload_psql_census.ps1` reported multiple parse errors beginning at Bash `<<'SQL'` and the SQL body.
- Guard: do not embed nested Bash heredocs inside PowerShell here-strings for executable handoff; use quoted one-line native commands or an externally staged file, then re-run whole-artifact parser proof.
### APEX_CHUNKED_GENERATION_SPLITS_POWERSHELL_HERESTRING
- Status: ACTIVE
- Trigger: multi-chunk file generation closes a PowerShell here-string in an early chunk and appends intended string content as executable PowerShell.
- Evidence: V2 census exact-byte inspection showed `$Remote = @'` terminated before the PostgreSQL commands, and the parser gate failed on the appended Bash/SQL lines.
- Guard: when an executable PowerShell here-string spans logical sections, generate that here-string atomically or use an external staged artifact; never close/reopen it implicitly across write chunks.
### APEX_PAYLOAD_PSQL_DEFAULT_SOCKET_NOT_LIVE_ENDPOINT
- Status: ACTIVE
- Trigger: read-only Payload DB census invoked `psql` without an explicit host and defaulted to `/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432`, while the live Payload session is TCP-backed.
- Failure mode: diagnostic reports socket-not-found even though Payload has an active PostgreSQL backend connection.
- Guard: derive or explicitly target the live TCP endpoint; never assume the default Unix socket represents the application database path.
- Repair rule: classify transport endpoint before DB census and stop immediately on deterministic remote DB-client failure.

### APEX_PAYLOAD_PSQL_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD_ASSUMPTION_DEFECT
- Status: ACTIVE
- Class: Production diagnostic / database authentication assumption
- Trigger: Read-only PostgreSQL census attempted TCP login as `postgres` without a known password even though the live Payload app already has valid application credentials.
- Required guard: Do not require or reset the PostgreSQL superuser password for Payload diagnostics. Prefer the live application's existing database binding/credentials or an already-authorized local path, and never expose secrets in output.
- Regression proof: A replacement census must authenticate using the same endpoint/role as the running Payload application and must remain read-only.

## APEX_USER_ADMIN_LOGIN_IP_PROXY_LOOPBACK_PERSISTENCE_DEFECT
- registeredUtc: 2026-09-21T03:55:00Z
- stage: Users administration login/network evidence audit
- trigger: Authentication persists `request.ip` directly into `users.last_login_ip` and `sessions.ip_address`; when the Gateway is reached through an untrusted or unconfigured local reverse proxy, the persisted value becomes the proxy/loopback address such as `127.0.0.1` instead of the originating client.
- risk: Administrators receive misleading login-origin evidence, while blindly trusting forwarded headers would allow spoofed IP attribution.
- guard: Resolve client and immediate peer addresses separately through an explicit trusted-proxy boundary; forwarded addresses are accepted only when the immediate peer is trusted. Persist both identities for login history and never trust arbitrary `X-Forwarded-For` from an untrusted peer.
- regressionRule: Direct clients ignore spoofed forwarded headers; loopback/trusted-proxy requests resolve the intended originating address; login/session/user records persist the same resolved client IP and separate peer IP.
- disposition: REGISTERED_BLOCKER_REPAIR_REQUIRED

## APEX_USER_ADMIN_BULK_MUTATION_PER_ROW_HTTP_PARTIAL_AUTHORITY_DEFECT
- registeredUtc: 2026-09-21T03:55:00Z
- stage: Users administration bulk-management audit
- trigger: The current web-admin bulk activation loops selected users and issues one status mutation HTTP request per row, without a server-owned bulk preview/apply transaction or query-scope authority.
- risk: Large operations can partially apply, race administrator-preservation invariants, generate inconsistent audit history, or leave the operator unable to distinguish skipped/protected rows from failed requests.
- guard: Bulk changes must be owned by one authenticated server endpoint with bounded cardinality, dry-run preview, explicit selection scope, administrative-invariant serialization, per-target disposition, audit correlation, and fail-closed result semantics.
- regressionRule: Preview is mutation-free; apply honors protected-administrator invariants; partial/skipped results are explicit; session-revoke/status/role bulk actions are bounded and audited under one correlation id.
- disposition: REGISTERED_BLOCKER_REPAIR_REQUIRED

### APEX_NODE_REPAIR_HELPER_TEMPLATE_LITERAL_INTERPOLATION_LEAK_DEFECT
- Date: 2026-09-22
- Scope: Users bulk-delete repair helper.
- Failure: the file-based Node repair helper embedded target TSX template literals inside its own JavaScript template literals without escaping `${...}`, so Node evaluated target identifiers such as `selectedCount` inside the helper and terminated with ReferenceError.
- Impact: the helper stopped mid-run after earlier bounded route/type mutations; no PASS may be claimed and the complete repair chain must be rerun from observed current state.
- Guard: file-based mutation helpers that carry target-language template literals must escape target `${...}` sequences or use non-interpolating construction. Repair helpers must be idempotent across a safely observed partial run and then re-run whole-artifact validation.
- Regression rule: helper parser PASS is insufficient; helper runtime must exit 0, emit the expected success token, stderr must be empty, and all intended file postconditions must be verified before validation proceeds.
- Disposition: REPAIR_REQUIRED.

### APEX_USER_FK_POLICY_PROOF_TREATS_NO_ACTION_AS_DELETE_SAFE_DEFECT
- Date: 2026-09-22
- Scope: users single/bulk delete production closeout.
- Failure: `user-fk-policy-proof.mjs` classifies PostgreSQL `confdeltype='n'` (NO ACTION) as safe alongside CASCADE, even though NO ACTION references can block physical user deletion with SQLSTATE 23503.

- Replacement policy: scoped `.v19-*` styles only; do not globally mutate shared address or legacy `.wt-*` primitives.

### VETERANS_2019_PRODUCTION_ASSET_PROBE_REGEX_ASSUMPTION

- Acceptance: resolved asset URL must return HTTP 200 and be checked for route/chunk references independently.

### VETERANS_2019_OVERRIDE_PACKAGING_PYTHON_UNAVAILABLE

- Regression: transport preparation must verify the selected runtime before relying on it.

### VETERANS_2019_THEME_CUTOVER_ACCEPTANCE_FAILED_ROLLED_BACK
- Failure class: bounded standalone CSS cutover hit a post-mutation acceptance assertion and exited 1.
- Rollback evidence: deployment trap emitted `ROLLBACK=PASS`; index was restored from the pre-mutation backup.
- Status: production theme fix remains UNVERIFIED/NOT DEPLOYED until the failing assertion is identified.
- Replacement rule: do not retry by changing only the last observed assertion; inspect stage, live index, HTTP cache behavior, asset hash, and health as a complete chain first.

### VETERANS_2019_PUBLIC_ACCEPTANCE_REQUEST_FAILS_AFTER_LOCAL_CUTOVER
- Failure class: local atomic index switch passed, but the subsequent public HTTP acceptance request failed before an HTTP PASS token could be emitted.

- Narrowed boundary: staged index, versioned asset existence/hash, and local cutover all passed before failure.
- Required next step: diagnose public request/redirect behavior independently, then re-run the complete cutover chain with the corrected acceptance URL.

### VETERANS_2019_STAGED_INDEX_OWNERSHIP_PRESERVATION_FAILURE
- Root cause: staged index was `root:root` mode 600; `cp -a` preserved that metadata into public_html.
- Production contract: live standalone index is `koudama:koudama` mode 600 and Apache access depends on that ownership.
- Observed effect: local cutover passed but public HTTP acceptance failed; rollback restored the live file.
- Regression: every standalone index cutover must preserve live ownership/mode explicitly and verify metadata before HTTP acceptance.
- Replacement: stage content only, then apply `chown --reference` and `chmod --reference` from the current live index before atomic rename.

## VETERANS2019_AMOUNT_RANGE_STEP_RESTRICTION
- date: 2026-09-30
- trigger: The Veterans 2019 survey amount input used `min="1" step="1000"`; mobile browser validation rejected values such as `260` and suggested the nearest valid values `1` and `1001`. The gateway also rejected `amount <= 0`.
- risk: Valid approximate compensation amounts can be blocked by presentation-layer step/range constraints, creating false form failures before submission.
- guard: The compensation amount field must remain required and numeric but must not define `min`, `max`, or `step`; gateway validation must require only a finite numeric value, with no range restriction.
- regression proof: Mobile browser must accept `260` with `checkValidity() === true`; source must contain no amount `min`/`max`/`step`; gateway isolated validation must accept finite test values without mutating production data.
- disposition: REGISTERED_FOR_REPAIR

## VETERANS2019_PM2_RESTART_NATIVE_FAILURE_CAPTURE_GAP
- date: 2026-09-30
- trigger: Bounded amount-validation cutover updated the live survey index, then `pm2 restart watany-gateway --update-env` returned nonzero while the Bash wrapper had `set -e`; the wrapper exited before recording native stdout, stderr, or the PM2 exit code.
- risk: A native child-process failure can terminate deployment evidence prematurely and obscure the actual failure cause; frontend and source mutations may already have occurred while backend runtime remains stale.
- guard: Before retrying any PM2/native restart, run fail-closed with errexit disabled only around the native command, capture stdout/stderr/exit separately, require exit 0 plus expected PM2 process state, health 200, and absence of failure tokens before PASS.
- disposition: REGISTERED_RETRY_BLOCKER

## VETERANS2019_PM2_HOME_RUNTIME_MISMATCH
- date: 2026-09-30
- trigger: Server command ran as UID root but `HOME=/home/dcagent`, so default `pm2` used `/home/dcagent/.pm2`, where no WatanyBot processes were registered. The real `watany-gateway` process is in `/root/.pm2` as PM2 id 2.
- risk: Restart commands can report process-not-found or target the wrong PM2 daemon even when executed as root.
- guard: For WatanyBot gateway process operations on this server, explicitly set `PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2`, confirm `watany-gateway` exists and is online before restart, then require a changed PID, PM2 online state, HTTP health 200, protected-route 401 unauthenticated, and no failure tokens.
- disposition: REGISTERED_FOR_RETRY

## VETERANS2019_BASH_ERREXIT_AND_LIST_FALSE_PASS
- date: 2026-09-30
- trigger: After restarting `watany-gateway`, health and unauthenticated API probes returned HTTP 503, but the Bash acceptance wrapper used `[ "$H" = 200 ] && [ "$U" = 401 ]` under `set -e`; because of Bash errexit exceptions for AND-lists, execution continued and printed `PROGRAM_STATUS=PASS`.
- risk: A failed runtime acceptance can be mislabeled PASS even when the expected HTTP status contract is not met.
- guard: Never rely on `set -e` for compound acceptance expressions. Use explicit `if ...; then ...; else exit N; fi` or `test ... || exit N` for every required proof, and emit the success token only after all explicit checks pass.
- disposition: REGISTERED_RUNTIME_PROOF_BLOCKER

- Evidence: production `/for-you` showed marquee bounds x=409..641 while `.ticker-track` right edge was x=300 at transform `translateX(-340.673px)`; all 18 ticker items were outside x=409..641 even though the track contained the expected text.
- Guard: for RTL max-content ticker tracks, browser proof must verify at least one ticker item intersects the marquee viewport at multiple timestamps after motion begins; DOM text count and changing transform alone are insufficient.
- Repair contract: reverse the manual transform direction for the RTL track, retain React as sole DOM owner, keep latest-mode refresh and no-store behavior, rebuild/typecheck, then prove continuous visible intersection and production propagation.

- trigger: `src/db/migrate.ts` applies `readdirSync(...).filter(.sql).sort()` and records the full filename in `_migrations`. `050_community_message_stars_text_identity.sql` alters `community_message_stars`, which is created by `20260626_community_message_stars.sql`; that filename sorts after every `0xx` file. - guard: Use an additive, earlier-sorting prerequisite (or equivalent ordering contract) that never renames or rewrites applied migrations and is idempotent on databases that already have the table. ## APPLICANT_HISTORY_DISCLOSED_BY_CALLER_SUPPLIED_PHONE
- registeredUtc: 2026-10-19T05:30:41Z
- stage: Source review and end-to-end test of GET /api/v2/jobs/my/applications in the production gateway source (release qwen35-ai-20261004T1115Z), isolated worktree, disposable PostgreSQL 16
- trigger: The handler returned marketplace_job_applications rows for any caller-supplied `?phone=`, with no authentication or owner link. Separately, the universal and Middle East security owner lookups used only the user id when both a session and an anonymous tracking token were present, hiding the applicant's anonymous applications.
- risk: Anyone who knows or guesses a phone number can read another applicant's job applications (name, phone, status). A phone number is not proof of ownership.
- guard: Applicant-facing lookups accept only proven ownership: the authenticated user id, or that subsystem's own tracking token stored as a hash and sent in a header (never the query string). Merge independently proven scopes once each with a source discriminator; explicit field projection (no admin notes or token hashes). Required tests: cross-user, phone, cross-subsystem token, wrong/malformed token, query-string token, merged scopes and field leakage, plus a control run against the old code. Fixed in f8c666a (control: 7 of 12 cases fail on the old code).
- disposition: REGISTERED_ACTIVE_GUARD


## ADMIN_GUARD_DERIVES_ROLE_FROM_REQUEST_HEADERS
- registeredUtc: 2026-10-19T05:30:41Z
- stage: Security review of src/routes/admin-auth-hardening-guards.ts in the production gateway source
- trigger: The onRequest guard computed the caller's role from x-user-role / x-admin-role / x-watany-role headers and from substrings ('SUPER', 'ROOT', 'ADMIN') of Authorization and other token headers. A probe with forged headers passed the guard on chat-messages, al-wafiyat and deaths (404 instead of 401); the DB-backed auth layer behind it still returned 401 on every existing route.
- risk: A second authorization layer that any client can satisfy gives false assurance; any route that relies on it alone is open to header forgery.
- guard: Authorization decisions use only the DB-backed principal (active user, live session, sid; role from the database). No role from request headers outside the explicit, development/test-only opt-in. Regression test with forged headers across every guarded prefix, including unknown child paths (must be 401), and a real admin session with forged superadmin headers (must be 403). Fixed in cbdcc14 (control: 23 of 43 cases fail on the old guard).
- disposition: REGISTERED_ACTIVE_GUARD
